subject: general
question: Which state has the lowest population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sikkim is the state with the lowest population in India, as per the **2011 Census of India**.
 
• The population of Sikkim was recorded at **6,10,577** in 2011, making it the least populated state in the country.
 
• Sikkim is located in the northeastern part of India and is known for its **mountainous terrain**.
 
• The state has a low population density of **86 people per square kilometer**, which is among the lowest in India.
 
• Sikkim is also the first fully **organic farming state** in the country, gaining international recognition for its sustainable practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geography of Sikkim:**

 
 
• Sikkim is bordered by Nepal to the west, Bhutan to the east, Tibet (China) to the north, and West Bengal to the south.
 
• The state is home to **Kangchenjunga**, the third-highest peak in the world, which is considered sacred by the local population.
 
 
 
• **Languages:** The official languages of Sikkim include Nepali, English, Sikkimese (Bhutia), and Lepcha.
 
• **Economy:** The state’s economy is primarily based on **agriculture, horticulture, and tourism**.
 
• **Culture:** Sikkim is known for its rich cultural heritage, including **Buddhist monasteries**, festivals, and traditional music and dance forms.
 
• **Recent Population Data:** While the 2011 Census is the latest comprehensive population data, estimates from the **2021-2023 period** suggest minor population growth, keeping Sikkim as the least populated state.
